Disabled in the Crucible.

Kills while Adrenal Rush is active grant Special Ammo Meter progress based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Rank-and-File Combatants: 3%.
• Enemies of the Elite Tier or higher: 16%, increased to 24% for Taken.
• Players: ?%.

Destroying destructible objects or Constructs while Adrenal Rush is active grants 16% Special Ammo Meter progress.

source.text:
4 Piece | Bountiful Munitions
>>DISABLED IN CRUCIBLE<<

While Adrenal Rush is active:
Rank-and-File Combatant Kills grant +3% Special Ammo Progress.
Elite+ Combatants Kills grant +16% Special Ammo Progress.
Elite+ Taken Combatant Kills grant +24% Special Ammo Progress.
Guardian Kills grant +?% Special Ammo Progress.
Buff can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs, granting +16% Special Ammo Progress.
